name: confluence-to-md
description: Fetch Confluence pages as Markdown and publish Markdown back to Confluence, following links to other pages.

confluenceToMd.token.description: Confluence token (Cloud: API token; Server/DC: Personal Access Token).

confluenceToMd.email.description: Atlassian account e-mail. Cloud only; Server/DC ignores it.

confluenceToMd.downloadFolder.description: Where to save downloaded pages. Empty = the folder of the active file. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

enumDescriptions: Insert a link to the Confluence attachment.
confluenceToMd.images.description: What to do with images on the page.

confluenceToMd.followLinks.description: After downloading a page, offer to download the pages it links to.

confluenceToMd.appendixHeading.description: Heading that starts the additional-materials section; every code block below it is extracted to a separate file. Empty = off.

scripts.test: node test/html-to-md-test.js && node test/md-to-storage-test.js && node test/client-test.js && node test/md-document-test.js && node test/download-folder-test.js && node test/page-link-test.js && node test/code-samples-test.js && node test/assemble-parts-test.js && node test/page-tree-test.js && node test/publish-command-test.js
